# DressYou

> Virtual try-on on your own twin. Essayage virtuel sur votre jumeau.

DressYou is a fashion app. Your own photos make your twin, and you try on clothes from any online shop, your wardrobe or the feed before you buy. The app also builds outfits from the clothes you own, lets friends vote between looks, and includes a stylist that answers from your wardrobe. The iPhone app is on the App Store. A Chrome extension is announced.


## Facts

- Name: DressYou
- Company: DressYou Technologies, 47 rue Vivienne, 75002 Paris, France
- Site: https://dressyouapp.com/ in English, https://dressyouapp.com/fr in French
- Contact: info@dressyouapp.com
- Status: iPhone app on the App Store
